results.text: Prospective audit of conversion from regular to lispro insulin during routine clinical care. Randomized controlled trials show that lispro insulin has the potential to improve glycaemic control. Observational, practice-based studies provide information that is complementary to that obtained from randomized controlled trials and results of both types of studies are of relevance when advising patients of likely outcomes during routine clinical care.

A Digital Diabetes Clinic Intervention for Individuals Starting Insulin Therapy: Randomized Controlled Trial. This randomized controlled trial evaluated the effects of a digital diabetes clinic continuous support program on metabolic, psychological, and social outcomes in individuals with type 2 diabetes who were recently initiated on insulin therapy.
